Basic chat completion request routed through the proxy

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
print(result)
```
